categories.reason: The prototype uses an original local responsive layout built for this service schedule.
Cards, rows, tabs, forms, and controls are original local CSS components with no package dependency.
Text buttons and native form controls communicate every action without an icon dependency.
The selected serif and sans pairing uses installed Georgia and Arial system fonts only.
The service schedule needs readable assignment content and no photographic context.
No illustration is needed for a fictional duty roster and religious imagery is excluded.
Short local state changes and reduced motion support cover the interaction without signature motion.
